name: Foreplay
summary: Search a library of Meta, TikTok and other platform ads and brands: creatives, transcripts, brand lookups by name or domain, and running-ad analytics.

api_key.description: A Foreplay API key (app.foreplay.co > API overview).

notes: Credits: 1 per ad returned on ad endpoints (a page of 250 ads costs 250), 1 per call on brand endpoints whatever the count; empty and error responses are free; usage is free. X-Credits-Remaining is on every response.
Ad lists page by cursor: pass metadata.cursor from the previous response.
Each ad carries foreplay_url, the link to view it in Foreplay.
Swipe file, boards and Spyder (your own saved and tracked brands) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search ads
endpoints.summary: Search the whole ad index by text and filters; each ad has media URLs, transcript, brand and targeting.

query.description: Text to match in ad name or description; empty searches with filters only.

start_date.description: Inclusive start, UTC: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (a bare date means 00:00:00).

end_date.description: Inclusive end, UTC; use YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59 to cover a whole day.

live.description: true for running ads, false for stopped; omit for both.

display_format.description: Formats: video, carousel, image, dco, dpa, multi_images, multi_videos, multi_medias, event, text, page_like.

publisher_platform.description: Platforms: facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger, tiktok, youtube, linkedin, threads, whatsapp.

niches.description: Niches, e.g. beauty, fashion, food/drink, health/wellness.

languages.description: Languages, as names or codes (en, french).

running_duration_min_days.description: Minimum days the ad has run.

running_duration_max_days.description: Maximum days the ad has run.

endpoints.name: Get an ad
endpoints.summary: One ad by its Foreplay id.

endpoints.name: Search brands by name
endpoints.summary: Brands matching a name, with total and active ad counts.

include_empty.description: Include brands with no indexed ads (hidden by default).

min_ads.description: Only brands with at least this many ads.

max_ads.description: Only brands with at most this many ads.

notes: 1 credit per call. Ad-count filters apply after ranking, so fewer than limit may come back.

endpoints.name: Find brands by domain
endpoints.summary: Brands that advertise from a website domain.

endpoints.name: Get ads by brand
endpoints.summary: Ads of one or more brands, with the same filters as search.

brand_ids.description: One or more Foreplay brand ids (from foreplay.brands.search).

start_date.description: Inclusive start, UTC: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (a bare date means 00:00:00).

end_date.description: Inclusive end, UTC; use YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59 to cover a whole day.

live.description: true for running ads, false for stopped; omit for both.

display_format.description: Formats: video, carousel, image, dco, dpa, multi_images, multi_videos, multi_medias, event, text, page_like.

publisher_platform.description: Platforms: facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger, tiktok, youtube, linkedin, threads, whatsapp.

niches.description: Niches, e.g. beauty, fashion, food/drink, health/wellness.

languages.description: Languages, as names or codes (en, french).

running_duration_min_days.description: Minimum days the ad has run.

running_duration_max_days.description: Maximum days the ad has run.

collect.description: When nothing is cached, fetch live from Meta and wait about 30 seconds.

notes: 1 credit per ad returned. collect=true is a best-effort fallback and may still return nothing.

endpoints.name: Get brand analytics
endpoints.summary: Daily rows of a brand's running-ad distribution and creative velocity.

id.description: Brand id (20-25 mixed-case characters) or numeric Facebook page id.

notes: 1 credit per call. Today's row is computed live from the latest collected data.

endpoints.name: Get credit usage
endpoints.summary: Remaining and total credits and the billing-cycle window.
